name: aurora-message-scroller
title: Aurora Message Scroller
author: jmagar <https://github.com/jmagar>
description: Conversation viewport primitive with pinned-end streaming follow, user-scroll yielding, anchored turns, preserved prepends, jump controls, and visibility hooks.
docs:
Aurora conversation-scroller primitive inspired by shadcn's MessageScroller composition, implemented locally with Aurora controls and tokens. Wrap the scroller in MessageScrollerProvider, then compose Viewport, Content, Item, and Button.

Registry dependencies: aurora-tokens, aurora-button, aurora-components.
